R7BF-bear-drive-0004.name: 720 m NW of Minaker River
R7BF-bear-drive-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BF-bear-drive-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), 50 m NW: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2021 (fire G80997), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SE facing slope, 12 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 18 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97.
Park: 57.48355, -123.00045, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 210 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 4 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-42, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-30, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BF-bear-drive-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-42: about 311 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 4 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
